hypothesis: Diagnostic-only synthetic NNE corridor pattern. This is not a geology-tested hypothesis: no feature or label raster was available in this checkout, and the generated pixels were not derived from measured geophysical evidence.
mechanism: Deterministic placement of 10,000 seeded centers on six hand-coded NNE-oriented corridors with 400 m random perpendicular jitter; each center burns a radius-2-pixel disk. The resulting raster has 129,311 positive pixels, not 10,000 positive pixels.
mimic: Unrelated linear geomorphic or lithologic boundaries, drainage/ridge lineaments, and synthetic cartographic regularity can mimic the hand-coded corridors; no data-driven test of these mimics was possible.
